description.description: What the expense was for, using information supplied by the user.

spent_on.description: Optional spending date in YYYY-MM-DD. Omit when unspecified; the backend supplies today.

category_id.description: An existing category ID supplied in context. Omit or use null when no category fits.

function.name: list_expenses
function.description: Open an interactive transaction or grouped totals table. Returns its ID and initial query metadata only.

start_date.description: Inclusive earliest spending date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit or null for no lower bound.

end_date.description: Inclusive latest spending date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit or null for no upper bound.

category_ids.description: Existing category IDs. Omit or use null for all categories. Use [null] for Uncategorized only.

min_amount.description: Inclusive minimum {{currency}} amount, as {{amount_format}}. Zero allowed. Omit or null for no minimum.

max_amount.description: Inclusive maximum {{currency}} amount, same format as min_amount. Omit or null for no maximum.

description_search.description: Literal text to find in expense descriptions, ignoring ASCII case. Blank or null means no search.

group_by.description: Omit or use [] for transactions. Use ["category"], ["month"], or ["month","category"] for spending totals. With both, months contain category subtotals.

sort_by.description: Sort by spending date (default) or amount.

function.name: summarize_expenses
function.description: Return {{currency}} spending metrics overall and optionally by category, month, or both. Each call covers one date range and excludes deleted expenses.

start_date.description: Inclusive earliest spending date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit or null for no lower bound.

end_date.description: Inclusive latest spending date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit or null for no upper bound.

category_ids.description: Existing category IDs. Omit or use null for all categories. Use [null] for Uncategorized only.

min_amount.description: Inclusive minimum {{currency}} amount, as {{amount_format}}. Zero allowed. Omit or null for no minimum.

max_amount.description: Inclusive maximum {{currency}} amount, same format as min_amount. Omit or null for no maximum.

description_search.description: Literal text to find in expense descriptions, ignoring ASCII case. Blank or null means no search.

group_by.description: Omit or use [] for overall metrics only. With both dimensions, returns flat month–category groups.

metrics.description: Default ["sum","count"]. avg, min and max operate on individual transactions overall and within each group.

sort_by.description: Grouped results only. Sort by a selected dimension or requested metric. Defaults to month if grouped by month, otherwise sum if requested or the first requested metric.

sort_order.description: Defaults to ascending for dimensions and descending for metrics.

limit.description: Maximum returned groups, default 24. Overall metrics always cover all matches.

function.name: find_expenses
function.description: Find up to five active expenses and their IDs for a correction or deletion. Returns matching_count and truncated.

start_date.description: Inclusive earliest spending date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit or null for no lower bound.

end_date.description: Inclusive latest spending date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit or null for no upper bound.

category_ids.description: Existing category IDs. Omit or use null for all categories. Use [null] for Uncategorized only.

min_amount.description: Inclusive minimum {{currency}} amount, as {{amount_format}}. Zero allowed. Omit or null for no minimum.

max_amount.description: Inclusive maximum {{currency}} amount, same format as min_amount. Omit or null for no maximum.

description_search.description: Literal text to find in expense descriptions, ignoring ASCII case. Blank or null means no search.

sort_by.description: Sort by spending date (default) or amount.

function.name: update_expense
function.description: Correct one active expense by ID. Omitted fields stay unchanged. {{currency}} only.

expense_id.description: Exact ID of the identified expense.

spent_on.description: Corrected spending date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to keep the existing date.

category_id.description: Existing category ID, or null for Uncategorized. Omit to keep the existing category.

description.description: Corrected description, or null to clear it. Omit to keep the existing description.

function.name: delete_expense
function.description: Delete one active expense by ID, immediately. Call once the exact expense the user means is identified; no confirmation is needed. The user can undo it.

expense_id.description: Exact ID of the identified expense.
